title: Initiative Orchestration: SLI Health Grid and Milestone Matrix
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Purpose: build a cross-functional orchestration artifact (SLI Health Grid + Milestone Matrix) to standardize how reliability initiatives are tracked, gated, and escalated across product, infra, and platform teams. The artifact combines quantitative SLI signals (latency P95, availability, error-rate), error-budget consumption velocity, and initiative milestones mapped to OKRs so PMs and Eng can make rapid, consistent rollout decisions.

Scope: 1) define the canonical column set and scoring rules for the SLI Health Grid, 2) design a Milestone Matrix template that maps initiative phases (Discovery, Build, Canary, Ramp, GA) to SLO gate thresholds and required artifacts, 3) instrument dashboards and a small automation that surfaces initiatives at-risk and recommended throttle/rollback actions, 4) handoff guidelines for oncall and incident response during experiments.

Out of scope: full enterprise RBAC for the orchestration UI (follow-up), long-term data retention changes (separate infra ticket).
acceptance_criteria: SLI Health Grid defined with at least 4 SLIs, scoring rules, and color thresholds documented in Confluence
Milestone Matrix template created and populated for two pilot initiatives (Dedicated Autoscaler and KV-cache eviction policy)
Dashboard prototype in Grafana/Console that joins initiative metadata with SLI time-series and error-budget burn-rate
Automation rule that triggers Slack alert when initiative enters RED for >2 hours with suggested rollback or canary hold action
Playbook section for oncall handoff and experiment rollback steps reviewed and signed off by Reliability leads
notes: Rationale: teams currently make ad-hoc rollout decisions; standardizing reduces cognitive load and speeds up safe rollouts
Scorecard approach chosen over binary gates to allow context-aware decisions (we weight latency vs availability by customer-impact tag)
We will pilot with 2 initiatives and iterate before wide rollout; pilot candidates: runtime-1.18 autoscaler and cache eviction changes
Security: no customer data is surfaced by the grid; only aggregated SLI metrics. KMS/HSM integration not required for this artifact

risks: Telemetry tagging lag: if initiative_id isn't present in metrics, grid will be incomplete
False positives from transient infra flakiness could trigger unnecessary rollbacks without context enrichment
Cross-team alignment required for thresholds; political risk if threshold tightening delays launches
